Definition: of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side:--side.
BiblicalUsage: Pleura is a side, a rib. A soldier pierced His side in John 19:34, and blood and water came out. The risen Jesus showed His disciples His hands and His side in John 20:20, and told Thomas to thrust his hand into His side in John 20:27.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pierced side is the proof of His death and the proof of His rising — the same wound, first for judgment, then for faith.
